Metrology/Characterization
Thin Film

Description
The TI 950 TriboIndenter nanoindenter is an automated, high throughput instrument to support nanomechanical and nanotribological characterization over the nano and microscales. The instruments also enables High Precision Scanning Probe Microscopy. 
Maximum Substrate Size
6 inch
